name: slack
description: Slack MCP: list channels/chats, read channel and thread history, search, send messages. Remote server, OAuth.
notes: Add to .cursor/mcp.json.source: "slack": { "url": "https://mcp.slack.com/mcp" }. Cursor is a supported partner; first use: connect Slack workspace (OAuth). Use for: get list of chats, analyze information from the Space/channel you granted access to. Requires Slack app (directory or internal) with MCP enabled and scopes for channels:history, search, etc.
